description_en: Deletes a session under the specified DataAgent
description_zh: 删除指定 DataAgent 下的一个会话
kebab_example: aliyun sls delete-thread --name order-analysis-agent --thread-id thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteThread

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent to which the session belongs
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to delete. This parameter is passed in the request path and returned by CreateThread
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
parameters.name: thread_id

schema.description_en: The response body. Only the request ID is returned when the deletion is successful
schema.description_zh: 响应体。删除成功时仅返回请求 ID

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is used to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent to which the session belongs
v1_parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
v1_parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to delete. This parameter is passed in the request path and returned by CreateThread
v1_parameters.help_zh: 要删除的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
v1_parameters.name: threadId
